text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Chatter, chatter... Murmur, murmur...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Hanshin Juvenile
Fillies, and
the audience is far more
worked up than usual for
this G1 race.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how this race is going to play
out! Man, I
can't wait!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
A lot of the Umamusume in this race are
aiming
for the Triple Tiara, and we've
got a seriously
good lineup of amazing
contenders this year.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
A lot of times, whoever wins this ends up
being
the star of their classic year! This
is one race
we've gotta keep our eye on!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wow... Everyone is so excited.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe I get to be a part of this...
I'm sure
even my parents are surprised
how big the crowd
is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm overwhelmed by how high
expectations are
for this G1 race. Just
thinking about how Nishino
Flower will
be running in this supercharged

environment makes me sick with nerves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I stress about whether she's managed to
shake off
all her fatigue ahead of today.
If she hasn't, and
she ends up getting
injured...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: What's wrong, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hm? Okay!
choice_data_list: L-let's go to the waiting room!

text_block_list.name: Racecourse Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Coming through! Come on,
keep it
moving!

text_block_list.name: Racecourse Staff B
text_block_list.text: R-right!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not just the spectators. The entire
racecourse
seems to quiver with nervous
anticipation.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Everyone looks so busy... I hope
everything's
okay.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Luckily, Nishino Flower seems
completely
unaffected. Just then...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Racer A
text_block_list.text:
Keep a close eye on me, Trainer. I've
finally made
it to this stage, and I intend
to win no matter
what!

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Don't get too worked up out there.
You're the
strongest Umamusume I've
worked with, and I
know you'll be fine.
You believe in me, right?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Racer A
text_block_list.text: I do! See you in a bit!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In their junior year, all Umamusume have
about
the same amount of experience.
Therefore, it's
their trainer's experience
that can make all the
difference.
choice_data_list: (If only I had that much experience...)
(If only I had that much experience...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If only I had met her when I had more
experience
as a trainer...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Why did I have to become race-ready so
early?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, well, um...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is so much more confident than
me.
They're so awesome and cool.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Compared to them, I'm still just a kid,
aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm smaller and weaker than everyone
else... I just
don't think I have the
confidence to run with
them...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The most important Umamusume in the
world to
me is standing here, anxious
and uneasy. Even if I
were an
experienced trainer, my failure to notice

her anxiety would be a gross oversight.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I've grown and improved so much
because of you,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower recognizes my efforts,
and the
person who knows better than
anyone how hard
she works and how
skilled she is... is me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's true that she isn't as physically
developed as
other racers, but that's
because she skipped a few
grades and
enrolled in Tracen Academy early.
Not
just anyone can do that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That alone is proof that she's got more
than
enough to overcome any
disadvantage!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
choice_data_list: Don't worry, I believe in you...!
Don't worry, I believe in you...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yeah... That's right. You do.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Hearing that is really
heartening. I...
feel a lot better.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer... I'm going to win today.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: And I'm going to do it for you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You can do it. I believe in you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You can do it. I believe in you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer's voice was trembling... But
that's no
surprise.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(This is Trainer's first G1 race too... I
guess we're
both nervous.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(But here I am, only thinking about
myself...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Why does it have to be now? I wish I'd
become
race-ready after I'd grown
bigger and taller.
Trainer's been working
so hard, but look at me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(But this isn't the time to be thinking
about that. I
want Trainer to feel more
confident. That's why I
chose to run
today! That's why...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I want to win.
